title: Праздник в зале  (Celebration in the Dining Room)

segments.t: Out in the dining room, Dmitry Nagiyev dances in brimming with joy, handing out cash bonuses to the staff and ordering champagne for every guest in the restaurant.
Да, мне очень нравится, как ты работаешь.
Молодец! А кому премия, Виктория Сергеевна?
Дмитрий Владимирович, а позвольте узнать повод?
Now let's go back through their conversation line by line and unpack the Russian phrasing.
'Guys! Hello! You are my good girl.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'guys' and finishing on 'good'.
Да, мне очень нравится, как ты работаешь.
'Yes, I really like how you work.' Dmitry Nagiyev brings out the contrast between 'yes' and 'to me' in a few short words.
Молодец! А кому премия, Виктория Сергеевна?
'Well done! And who gets a bonus, Viktoria Sergeyevna?' The grammar packs 'well done' and 'bonus' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'Who gets a bonus?' Notice how Russian expresses 'to whom' and 'bonus' with crisp inflection rather than helper words.
'Are there many people in the dining room?' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'people' before landing on 'hall'.
'About fifteen people.' Vika brings out the contrast between 'man' and 'fifteen' in a few short words.
'Ladies and gentlemen, good champagne for everyone!' Dmitry Nagiyev anchors the line on 'gentlemen', while 'good' completes the thought. Vika answers right away.
'Thank you!' The grammar packs 'thank you' and 'thank you' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
Дмитрий Владимирович, а позвольте узнать повод?
'Dmitry Vladimirovich, may I ask the occasion?' In Russian, the idea of 'and' flows naturally into 'occasion' without extra filler words.
'Well, I will allow it!' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'come on' and finishing on 'will allow'.
'Champagne for everyone on my tab!' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'to everyone' and finishing on 'score'.
'Wonderful news!' Notice how Russian expresses 'great' and 'news' with crisp inflection rather than helper words. Alright, let's hear the entire conversation one more time from start to finish.
Да, мне очень нравится, как ты работаешь.
Молодец! А кому премия, Виктория Сергеевна?
Дмитрий Владимирович, а позвольте узнать повод?
And that finishes Scene Three. Listen for Nagiyev's boundless generosity as he calls for good champagne for the entire room.
